title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate the diffusion of mask-wearing behavior in a population under social influence, policy interventions, supply constraints, and perceived disease risk, optionally coupled to disease transmission.

interactions.name: SocialInfluence
interactions.description: Individuals influence each other’s mask adoption via their social network; adoption probability increases with neighbor adoption and influence weights.

interactions.name: PolicyEffect
interactions.description: Mandates, subsidies, and public messaging alter adoption thresholds and compliance probabilities.

interactions.name: SupplyConstraint
interactions.description: Mask availability and price from retailers constrain purchases and replacement behavior.

interactions.name: DiseaseTransmission
interactions.description: Contacts at locations can transmit infection; mask usage reduces transmission probability via source control and wearer protection.

interactions.name: EnforcementInteraction
interactions.description: Locations and authorities enforce mask rules, leading to warnings/fines that modify future compliance.

interactions.name: MediaExposure
interactions.description: Media messages affect risk perception and trust, altering adoption probabilities.

interactions.name: HouseholdNorms
interactions.description: Households develop shared norms and resource pooling that affect member adoption and mask availability.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate during the simulation period.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until adoption reaches 50% of the population.

metrics.name: cumulative_infections
metrics.description: Total number of infections over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: infection_incidence_over_time
metrics.description: New infections per day across the simulation period.

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number_Rt
metrics.description: Estimated time-varying reproduction number reflecting transmission under current behaviors.

metrics.name: equity_gap_in_adoption
metrics.description: Difference in mask adoption between low- and high-income groups.

metrics.name: compliance_rate_in_mandated_locations
metrics.description: Share of agents complying with mask rules in locations with mandates.

metrics.name: average_mask_availability
metrics.description: Average per-capita mask inventory among agents.

metrics.name: policy_cost
metrics.description: Total cost of subsidies and enforcement actions.

metrics.name: npi_effectiveness
metrics.description: Estimated infections averted relative to a no-mask baseline.
